pdf-lib 1.17.1 (MIT); pdfjs-dist 5.6.205 legacy browser build (Apache-2.0). Licenses bundled in pdf-lib-LICENSE.txt and pdfjs-LICENSE.txt.
PDF vector fonts: Notebook Sans Regular/Semibold, derived from Noto Sans SC (Google Fonts, SIL Open Font License 1.1). Static weights 400/600 and glyph subset for this question bank; names changed. Original copyright/license retained in NotoSansSC-OFL.txt.
Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notosanssc
Font engine: @pdf-lib/fontkit 1.1.1 (MIT); license in fontkit-LICENSE.txt.
Fonts and tools are hosted locally, work offline, and do not call a font CDN.
